title: Reading data displays
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.stat.displays.dotplot: Each dot is one data value. Count dots, not columns.
hints.stat.displays.bars: Read each bar against the scale. "How many more" means subtract; "in all" means add.
hints.stat.displays.boxplot: The line in the box is the median. The box edges are Q1 and Q3; the whiskers end at the min and max.
hints.stat.displays: Dot plot: each dot is one value. Bar graph: read the scale. Box plot: the line is the median, the box is Q1 to Q3.

misconceptionMessages.stat.dotplot-columns: Count every dot, not the columns. Each dot is one data value.
misconceptionMessages.stat.dotplot-middle-value: The median is the middle dot, not the middle of the number line. Count dots from the left.
misconceptionMessages.stat.bar-read-one: That's one bar. Read the question again: it asks for a difference or a total.
misconceptionMessages.stat.bar-added: "How many more" means subtract the two bars.
misconceptionMessages.stat.box-quartile: That's a box edge (a quartile). The median is the line inside the box; the IQR is the width of the box.
misconceptionMessages.stat.box-middle: The median is the line inside the box. It isn't always halfway between the ends.
misconceptionMessages.stat.iqr-range: Range = max − min (whisker to whisker). Interquartile range = Q3 − Q1 (the width of the box).

sections.title: Dot plots
sections.objective: Read counts, the mode and the median from a dot plot.
explain: A dot plot puts one dot above the number line for every data value.

steps: Tallest column at 2: the mode is 2
The middle dot is number 4: it's at 2, so the median is 2

sections.key: Each dot is one value. Tallest column = the mode. Median = the middle dot, counting from the left.

sections.title: Bar graphs
sections.objective: Read a bar, compare two bars and find a total.
explain: Each bar's height, read against the scale, is how many are in that group.

steps: How many more chose Blue than Red? 14 − 8 = 6

sections.key: Read across to the scale. "How many more": subtract. "How many in all": add every bar.

sections.title: Box plots
sections.objective: Read the median, range and interquartile range.
explain: A box plot shows five numbers: the minimum, Q1, the median, Q3 and the maximum. The box holds the middle half of the data.

steps: Whiskers end at the min (2) and max (18)
The box goes from Q1 = 6 to Q3 = 14; the line is the median, 9

sections.key: The line in the box is the median. Range = max − min. Interquartile range (IQR) = Q3 − Q1, the width of the box.

sections.title: Putting it together
explain: Now the displays are mixed. Look at what kind of picture it is, then read what the question asks.
sections.key: Dot plot: each dot is one value. Bar graph: read the scale. Box plot: line = median, box = Q1 to Q3.
